item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Identify practical probes for mismatch between random masked-item training and terminal next-item inference. Compare terminal-mask and interior-mask losses, ranking margins, and gradient agreement within the same BERT4Rec model, stratified by history length and item frequency. Seek controlled tests that distinguish objective mismatch from popularity effects while preserving left padding, appended-MASK inference, and target isolation.","query":"BERT4Rec masked item prediction next item objective mismatch terminal masking gradient alignment diagnostic probes 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Develop paired history interventions to test whether recommendations depend on recent coherent activity or stale historical similarity. Seek deletion, truncation, and order-perturbation probes with matched random controls, uncertainty estimates, and safeguards against out-of-distribution artifacts. These measure model sensitivity; they cannot establish actual ownership, fulfilled needs, or purchase intent.","query":"sequential recommendation counterfactual history interventions recency preference drift deletion perturbation faithfulness diagnostic evaluation 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Find methods to turn observed qualitative feedback into trustworthy failure-mode measurements, separating choose-now, defer, reject, and cannot-assess responses. Investigate evidence-grounded coding from available titles, descriptions, and histories, abstention for unsupported compatibility claims, and category-level uncertainty for only five feedback users per category. Keep these diagnostics separate from the fixed macro validation HR@10 selection metric.","query":"recommender systems qualitative user feedback diagnostic taxonomy deferred choice uncertainty abstention missing item metadata small sample calibration 2024 2025 2026"}]}
